palawan.name: Hue Hotels and Resorts Puerto Princesa
palawan.description: Hue offers a rooftop pool, Aminah Spa and Filipino dining at LA-UD Restaurant. Its San Manuel address on Puerto Princesa North Road makes it a city base for a road trip to Mitra's Ranch in Santa Monica.

sources.supports: Current property existence, exact San Manuel / Puerto Princesa North Road address, rooftop pool, Aminah Spa, LA-UD Restaurant and Filipino cuisine. Official Book Now link goes to simplebooking.it hotel 6709.
Ranch address is Mitra Road, Barangay Santa Monica, Puerto Princesa; road access from city proper by tricycle, van or national-highway jeepney/multicab.

2025 official post-tour site-validation itinerary pairs Hue Hotel accommodation and LA-UD lunch with a Mitra's Ranch / Baker's Hill visit. Do not turn itinerary timings into hotel-to-ranch drive times.

vigan.name: Hotel Luna
vigan.description: Hotel Luna combines a restored mansion and art museum with a swimming pool and gym. Its address at V. Delos Reyes and Gen. Luna streets places it in Vigan's Heritage Village near Calle Crisologo.

sources.supports: Current hotel existence; restored mansion with art; Heritage Village location; exact V. Delos Reyes / Gen. Luna address.
Museum, swimming pool and gym are separately named facilities.
Hotel Luna is listed near Calle Crisologo. Do not publish a precise walking time; platform distances are not uniformly consistent with other travel websites.

cebu.name: Fantasy Lodge Cebu
cebu.description: Fantasy Lodge Cebu offers rooms, a swimming pool, kawa hot baths and massage treatments in Dalahikan, Samboan. The lodge lists Binalayan Hidden Falls among its local activities, making it a practical base for exploring Samboan's waterfalls.

sources.supports: Official resort location in Dalahikan, Samboan, South Cebu.
Swimming pool, kawa hot bath, massage with Tañon Strait views.
Binalayan Hidden Falls specifically listed as a Samboan activity from Fantasy Lodge. Avoid publishing travel duration even though resort quotes an estimate.
Verified booking listing and property existence.

siquijor.name: Coco Grove Beach Resort
siquijor.description: Coco Grove Beach Resort offers air-conditioned cottages and villas, three swimming pools, and three restaurants. Its beachfront setting in Tubod, San Juan provides a base in the same municipality as Paliton Beach.

sources.supports: Air-conditioned cottages and villas, beach location, three swimming pools, three restaurants.
Official provincial tourism accommodation listing gives Tubod, San Juan address and resort website.
